description: 适用于随机试验结果报告；执行可识别结构检查，并要求作者完成官方清单与流程图核对。
descriptionEn: For randomized-trial reports; performs identifiable structure checks and requires author confirmation against the official checklist and flow diagram.

rules.message: 请确认标题明确标识随机试验，摘要采用目标期刊要求的结构。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that the title identifies the study as randomized and that the abstract follows the target journal's structure.

rules.message: 请确认试验注册信息和数据共享计划已经报告。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that trial registration and the data-sharing plan are reported.

rules.message: 请逐项完成 CONSORT 2025 官方清单，并准备参与者流程图；本检查不替代官方清单。
rules.messageEn: Complete the official CONSORT 2025 checklist and participant flow diagram; this check does not replace the official checklist.
